$comment: Vendored for offline tests (no network at test time). The in-toto Attestation Framework publishes no JSON Schema for Statement v1; this file transcribes the normative sources of in-toto/attestation at commit fd2609c16bcb0ac53443e2b4612977f997e8f9a5 (Apache-2.0, Copyright 2021 in-toto Developers): spec/v1/statement.md, spec/v1/resource_descriptor.md, spec/v1/digest_set.md, spec/v1/field_types.md (TypeURI), spec/v1/README.md (parsing rules: extension fields allowed), and the reference validators go/v1/statement.go (Statement.Validate) and go/v1/resource_descriptor.go (digest hex encoding and byte lengths per algorithm).
title: in-toto Statement v1

_type.$comment: statement.md: always https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1 for this version of the spec.

subject.$comment: statement.md + go/v1 Statement.Validate: at least one subject; v1 statements require digest set on every subject.

predicate.$comment: statement.md: object, optional; unset is treated the same as set-but-empty.

TypeURI.$comment: field_types.md: RFC 3986 URI, case normalized (scheme and authority lowercase).

ResourceURI.$comment: field_types.md: RFC 3986 URI, case normalized (scheme and authority lowercase).

ResourceDescriptor.$comment: resource_descriptor.md: all fields optional but at least one of uri, digest, content; unrecognized (extension) fields are allowed.

DigestSet.$comment: digest_set.md: algorithm name -> lowercase hex for the named standard algorithms; byte lengths from go/v1 resource_descriptor.go (hex length = 2 x bytes); git object algorithms accept SHA-1 or SHA-256; custom algorithms are allowed and unconstrained beyond being strings.
